label: SOFTWARE-ASSISTED DIAGNOSTIC RECONSTRUCTION — NOT AN ACCEPTED TERRA GENERATION

decisions.why: Lawn lay 0.5 m outside the declared 110×80 m site. NOTE: the brief gives no site size (Terra declared it), but if the plot is real and fixed this enlargement is NOT permitted; the alternative is shrinking the lawn instead.

Clears the 0.5×6 m overlap. Shifts the salon, veranda, pool, lawn, dining/kitchen/service chain 4.5 m east relative to the entry hall and breaks the entry/salon axis. Chosen from 6 valid options; not Terra's.
Dining room now shares its south wall with the deck; kitchen/pantry/laundry/yard chain shifts 2 m south.
Pantry and east wing share no wall (6 m gap). Rerouted the wing's only link through the outdoor service yard. NOT acceptable architecture by default: bedrooms entered via the service yard.
Bed overlapped four rooms; removed. Not an approved design decision.
Largest width that fits between the deck and the east wing (37.5% smaller).
Screen blocked the entry door and stood in the arrival court. Removed; Terra's arrival-screen idea is lost. Not an approved design decision.
